        Not(IsBlank(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditPeriod_BodyContent_EuroMWh_1.Value)),

)

    LookUp(Choices('Land Lease Aggregation'), Value = 952850000)
)

If(
    tgl_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditContractPeriod_BodyContent_OneTimePayment.Checked && IsBlank(locSelectedLandLeaseCost),
    Or(
        Not(IsBlank(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditPeriod_BodyContent_EuroMWh_1.Value)),
        Not(IsBlank(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditPeriod_BodyContent_EuroMW_1.Value)),
        Not(IsBlank(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditPeriod_BodyContent_EuroWTG_1.Value)),

        Not(IsBlank(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditPeriod_BodyContent_FixedCosts_1.Value))
    ),
    Not(IsBlank(locSelectedLandLeaseCost)) && locSelectedLandLeasePeriod.Period='Land Lease Period'.'Period 1',
    Or(
        Not(IsBlank(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditPeriod_BodyContent_EuroMWh_1.Value)),
        Not(IsBlank(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditPeriod_BodyContent_EuroMW_1.Value)),
        Not(IsBlank(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditPeriod_BodyContent_EuroWTG_1.Value)),

        Not(IsBlank(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditPeriod_BodyContent_FixedCosts_1.Value))
    ),true
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    tgl_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_CountryInflationProfile_1.Checked,
    DisplayMode.Disabled,
    locSelectedLandLeasePeriod.Period = 'Land Lease Period'.'Period 1' || IsBlank(locSelectedLandLeaseCost),
    DisplayMode.Edit,
    DisplayMode.Disabled
)

ControlPropertyState.AutoRuleBindingString:
If(
    And(
        Not(IsBlank(locSelectedLandLeaseCost)),
        Not(tgl_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_CountryInflationProfile_1.Checked)
    ),
    Text(
        locSelectedLandLeaseCost.'Inflation Profile',
        "0.0"
    ),
    And(
        gblSelectedProject.Country.Name = "Italy",
        tgl_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_CountryInflationProfile_1.Checked
    ),
    Text(
        Max(
            LookUp(
                'Country Inflation Profiles',
                And(
                    Country.Country = gblSelectedProject.Country.Country,
                    Year = Value(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_InflationStartYear_1.Value),
                    Area = drp_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_AreaInflationProfile_1.Selected.Value
                )
            ).Inflation,
            0
        ),
        "0.0"
    ),
    tgl_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_CountryInflationProfile_1.Checked,
    Text(
        Max(
            LookUp(
                'Country Inflation Profiles',
                And(
                    Country.Country = gblSelectedProject.Country.Country,
                    Year = Value(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_InflationStartYear_1.Value)
                )
            ).Inflation,
            0
        ),
        "0.0"
    )
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    tgl_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_CountryInflationProfile_1.Checked,
    "",
    If(
        And(
            Not(IsBlank(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_InflationProfile_1.Value)),
            Not(fn_Numeric_LL.IsOneDecimal(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_InflationProfile_1.Value))
        ),
        $"Value must be a numeric with 1 decimal place",
        And(
            IsNumeric(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_InflationProfile_1.Value),
            Not(
                And(
                    Value(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_InflationProfile_1.Value) >= 0,
                    Value(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_InflationProfile_1.Value) <= 100
                )
            )
        ),
        $"Please select a value between 0 and 100.",
        Not(IsNumeric(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_InflationProfile_1.Value)),
        "Value must be a number with 1 decimal place"
    )
)

ControlPropertyState.AutoRuleBindingString:
If(
    And(
        Not(IsBlank(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_InflationProfile_1.Value)),
        Not(fn_Percentage_Opex.IsPercentage(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_InflationProfile_1.Value))
    ),
    $"Value must be a number with 1 decimal place",
    And(
        IsNumeric(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_InflationProfile_1.Value),
        Not(
            And(
                Value(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_InflationProfile_1.Value) >= 0,
                Value(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_InflationProfile_1.Value) <= 100
            )
        )
    ),
    $"Please select a value between 0 and 100.",
        Not(IsNumeric(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_InflationProfile_1.Value)),"Value must be a number with 1 decimal place"
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    locSelectedLandLeasePeriod.Period='Land Lease Period'.'Period 1' || IsBlank(locSelectedLandLeaseCost),
    DisplayMode.Edit,
    DisplayMode.Disabled
)

If(
    And(
        Not(IsBlank(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_Amount_1.Value)),
        Not(fn_Numeric_LL.IsTwoDecimal(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_Amount_1.Value))
    ),
    $"Value must be a number",
    Not(
        fn_Numeric_LL.InRange(
            txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_Amount_1.Value,
            0,
            1000000000
        )
    ),
    $"Please select a value between 0 and {Text(
        1000000000,
        "#,##0.0#"
    )}."
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    locSelectedLandLeasePeriod.Period='Land Lease Period'.'Period 1' || IsBlank(locSelectedLandLeaseCost),
    DisplayMode.Edit,
    DisplayMode.Disabled
)

If(
    And(
        Not(IsBlank(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_Amount2_1.Value)),
        Not(fn_Numeric_LL.IsTwoDecimal(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_Amount2_1.Value))
    ),
    $"Value must be a number",
    Not(
        fn_Numeric_LL.InRange(
            txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_Amount2_1.Value,
            0,
            1000000000
        )
    ),
    $"Please select a value between 0 and {Text(
        1000000000,
        "#,##0.0#"
    )}."
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    locSelectedLandLeasePeriod.Period='Land Lease Period'.'Period 1' || IsBlank(locSelectedLandLeaseCost),
    DisplayMode.Edit,
    DisplayMode.Disabled
)

If(
    And(
        Not(IsBlank(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_Amount3_1.Value)),
        Not(fn_Numeric_LL.IsTwoDecimal(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_Amount3_1.Value))
    ),
    $"Value must be a number",
    Not(
        fn_Numeric_LL.InRange(
            txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_Amount3_1.Value,
            0,
            1000000000
        )
    ),
    $"Please select a value between 0 and {Text(
        1000000000,
        "#,##0.0#"
    )}."
)

If(
    Or(
        Not(IsBlank(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditPeriod_BodyContent_FixedCosts_1.Value)),
        Not(IsBlank(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditPeriod_BodyContent_PercentOfRevenues_1.Value)),
        Not(IsBlank(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditPeriod_BodyContent_EuroMWh_1.Value)),
        Not(IsBlank(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditPeriod_BodyContent_EuroMW_1.Value)),
        Not(IsBlank(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditPeriod_BodyContent_EuroWTG_1.Value))
    ),
    false,
    If(
        And(
            Or(
                Not(IsBlank(locSelectedLandLeasePeriod.'Fixed Costs')),
                Not(IsBlank(locSelectedLandLeasePeriod.'% of Revenues')),
                Not(IsBlank(locSelectedLandLeasePeriod.'EUR/WTG')),
                Not(IsBlank(locSelectedLandLeasePeriod.'EUR/MW')),
                Not(IsBlank(locSelectedLandLeasePeriod.'EUR/MWh'))
            ),
            With(
                {
                    varLastPeriod: Last(
                        Sort(
                            Filter(
                                colLandLeasePeriods,
                                'Project Cost'.'Land Lease Project Cost' = locSelectedLandLeaseCost.'Land Lease Project Cost'
                            ),
                            Period
                        )
                    )
                },
                If(
                    locSelectedLandLeasePeriod.Period < varLastPeriod.Period,
                    true,
                    false
                )
            )
        ),
        true,
        false
    )
)
"Warning: Saving is not possible, because additional periods exist, Please delete them first."
"Please fill in at least one commercial figure"

If(
    IsBlank(locSelectedLandLeaseCost) || locSelectedLandLeasePeriod.Period = 'Land Lease Period'.'Period 1',
    And(
        IsBlank(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditPeriod_BodyContent_FixedCosts_1.Value),
        IsBlank(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditPeriod_BodyContent_PercentOfRevenues_1.Value),
        IsBlank(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditPeriod_BodyContent_EuroMWh_1.Value),
        IsBlank(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditPeriod_BodyContent_EuroMW_1.Value),
        IsBlank(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditPeriod_BodyContent_EuroWTG_1.Value),
        IsBlank(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_Amount_1.Value),
        IsBlank(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_DueDate_1.Value)
    ),
    And(
        IsBlank(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditPeriod_BodyContent_FixedCosts_1.Value),
        IsBlank(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditPeriod_BodyContent_PercentOfRevenues_1.Value),
        IsBlank(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditPeriod_BodyContent_EuroMWh_1.Value),
        IsBlank(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditPeriod_BodyContent_EuroMW_1.Value),
        IsBlank(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditPeriod_BodyContent_EuroWTG_1.Value)
        //,
        //IsBlank(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_Amount_1.Value),
        //IsBlank(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_DueDate_1.Value)
    )
)

            true
        ),
        If(
            gblSelectedProject.Country.Name = "Italy" && tgl_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_InflationProfile_1.Checked && tgl_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_CountryInflationProfile_1.Checked,
            Not(IsBlank(drp_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_AreaInflationProfile_1.Selected.Value)),
            true
        ),
        If(
            tgl_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_InflationProfile_1.Checked && Not(tgl_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_CountryInflationProfile_1.Checked),
            Not(IsBlank(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_InflationProfile_1.Value)),
            true
        ),
        If(
            tgl_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditContractPeriod_BodyContent_OneTimePayment.Checked,
            And(
                Not(IsBlank(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_DueDate_1.Value)),
                Not(IsBlank(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_Amount_1.Value))
            ),
            And(
                Not(IsBlank(drp_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditPeriod_BodyContent_DurationMonths_1.Selected.Value)),
                Not(IsBlank(drp_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditPeriod_BodyContent_DurationYears_1.Selected.Value)),
                Not(
                    And(
                        drp_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditPeriod_BodyContent_DurationYears_1.Selected.Value = 0,
                        drp_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditPeriod_BodyContent_DurationMonths_1.Selected.Value = 0
                    )
                ),
                If(
                    Or(
                        gblSelectedProject.Technology = Technology.PV,
                        gblSelectedProject.Technology = Technology.Wind
                    ),
                    And(
                        Not(IsBlank(drp_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditPeriod_BodyContent_Aggregation_1.Selected.Value)),
                        Not(IsBlank(cmb_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_AllocationWtg_1.Selected.Name))
                    ),
                    true
                ),
                Not(IsBlank(drp_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_DistributionFrequency_Month_1.Selected.Value))
            )
        ),
        If(
            locShowSecondPayment,
            And(
                Not(IsBlank(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_DueDate2_1.Value)),
                Not(IsBlank(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_Amount2_1.Value))
            ),
            true
        ),
        If(
            locShowThirdPayment,
            And(
                Not(IsBlank(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_DueDate3_1.Value)),
                Not(IsBlank(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_Amount3_1.Value))
            ),
            true
        ),
        If(
            And(
                tgl_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditContractPeriod_BodyContent_OneTimePayment.Checked,
                Or(
                    Not(IsBlank(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditPeriod_BodyContent_FixedCosts_1.Value)),
                    Not(IsBlank(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditPeriod_BodyContent_PercentOfRevenues_1.Value)),
                    Not(IsBlank(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditPeriod_BodyContent_EuroMWh_1.Value)),
                    Not(IsBlank(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditPeriod_BodyContent_EuroMW_1.Value)),
                    Not(IsBlank(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditPeriod_BodyContent_EuroWTG_1.Value))
                )
            ),
            And(
                Not(IsBlank(drp_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditPeriod_BodyContent_DurationMonths_1.Selected.Value)),
                Not(IsBlank(drp_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditPeriod_BodyContent_DurationYears_1.Selected.Value)),
                Not(
                    And(
                        drp_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditPeriod_BodyContent_DurationYears_1.Selected.Value = 0,
                        drp_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditPeriod_BodyContent_DurationMonths_1.Selected.Value = 0
                    )
                ),
                If(
                    Or(
                        gblSelectedProject.Technology = Technology.PV,
                        gblSelectedProject.Technology = Technology.Wind
                    ),
                    And(
                        Not(IsBlank(drp_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditPeriod_BodyContent_Aggregation_1.Selected.Value)),
                        Not(IsBlank(cmb_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_AllocationWtg_1.Selected.Name))
                    ),
                    true
                ),
                Not(IsBlank(drp_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_DistributionFrequency_Month_1.Selected.Value))
            ),
            //true 
// Changed for Having mandatory for New Period
            If(
                And(
                    Not(IsBlank(locSelectedLandLeaseCost)),
                    IsBlank(locSelectedLandLeasePeriod),
                    locRightPanelState = "New"
                ),
                And(
                    Not(IsBlank(drp_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditPeriod_BodyContent_DurationMonths_1.Selected.Value)),
                    Not(IsBlank(drp_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditPeriod_BodyContent_DurationYears_1.Selected.Value)),
                    Not(
                        And(
                            drp_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditPeriod_BodyContent_DurationYears_1.Selected.Value = 0,
                            drp_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditPeriod_BodyContent_DurationMonths_1.Selected.Value = 0
                        )
                    ),
                    If(
                        Or(
                            gblSelectedProject.Technology = Technology.PV,
                            gblSelectedProject.Technology = Technology.Wind
                        ),
                        And(
                            Not(IsBlank(drp_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditPeriod_BodyContent_Aggregation_1.Selected.Value)),
                            Not(IsBlank(cmb_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_AllocationWtg_1.Selected.Name))
                        ),
                        true
                    ),
                    Not(IsBlank(drp_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_DistributionFrequency_Month_1.Selected.Value))
                ),
                true
            )
        ),
        Not(con_LandLease_WarningOnSaveWithCost.Visible)
    ),
    DisplayMode.Edit,
    DisplayMode.Disabled
)
